title: Termination property test for the next loop
description: WHY: a directive system you can property-test is one you can trust; the property is that following next never loops forever. WHAT: build a simulation harness over the runtime (no CLI process spawning; drive the engine directly like tests/runtime does) that starts from a set of reachable fixture states - ready work, blocked chains, open declared gates, expired reservations, container hierarchies - and repeatedly executes the state transition each next directive prescribes, asserting the sequence reaches a closed work item or an explicit escalation directive within a bounded step count. Escalation directives (anything whose command requires a human decision, for example force-gate paths) are terminal for the test. Randomize over a seeded generator so failures reproduce, and keep the state space small enough to run in CI. Every non-terminating counterexample found during development gets minimized and pinned as a regression case.
acceptanceCriteria: Seeded property test runs in CI asserting bounded termination from all fixture start states
At least the four canonical start states from the bwrk next task are covered plus randomized dependency chains
pnpm test passes with the harness included
closedReason: Termination property harness is implemented and validated in the full suite.
